decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason For Grant:

The London Borough of Hounslow, as the Local Planning Authority, hereby certifies that on 25 October 2004 the proposed single storey rear extension would, because its volume of 42.04 cu metres, comply with the 50 cubic metres permitted development rights for terraced residential dwellinghouses. The overall volume of the proposed extension (42.04cubic metres) would be permitted development. It would therefore be lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The overall volume of (42.04cubic.m for the proposed extension would give rise to an extension to the original premises of  under 50 cubic metres and would fall within Schedule 2, Part 1, A of the Town and Country Planning General (Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of single storey rear extension.
